about: Twelve lines the owner might type during the 60-minute synthetic call, one per planted fact (all but the last), each started 6 to 45 seconds after the lines it notes end. captured_ms is when the line got its first character, from the call's start; about lists the transcript's utterances (0-based indices) the line was written about.
